{"reason":"Change the medium-or-higher branch from alternative-supplier to alert-planner. All 34 supplier switches cost 45,000 each, whereas alert-planner costs 35,000 and always arrives in time; it also prevents stockouts seen at medium inventory-days 2.8 and 5.3. Projected cost is 1,225,000 with zero stockouts versus 2,165,000 and four; fitness improves from -2.565 to -1.225.","source":"(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'high))
          (< inventory-days 5))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
